import java.util.*;

    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static int readInt(Scanner sc) {
        int x = 0, sign = 1;
        String token = sc.next();
        int idx = 0;
        if (token.charAt(0) == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            idx = 1;
        }
        for (int i = idx; i < token.length(); i++) {
            x = x * 10 + (token.charAt(i) - '0');
        }
        return x * sign;
    }

    static long modPow(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long modInverse(long a) {
        return modPow(a, MOD - 2);
    }

    static void addMod(int[] a, int index, int b) {
        a[index] = (int)(((long)a[index] + b) % MOD);
        if (a[index] < 0) a[index] += MOD;
